clean_baseline.name: Clean Baseline
clean_baseline.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

snr_20db.name: Additive Noise (+20 dB SNR)
snr_20db.transformation_type: Gaussian white noise added at +20 dB SNR
snr_20db.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

snr_10db.name: Additive Noise (+10 dB SNR)
snr_10db.transformation_type: Gaussian white noise added at +10 dB SNR
snr_10db.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

snr_5db.name: Additive Noise (+5 dB SNR)
snr_5db.transformation_type: Broadband noise added at +5 dB SNR
snr_5db.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

snr_0db.name: Additive Noise (0 dB SNR)
snr_0db.transformation_type: Heavy broadband noise equal to speech power (0 dB SNR)
snr_0db.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

gain_minus_12db.name: Gain Attenuation (-12 dB)
gain_minus_12db.transformation_type: Waveform amplitude scaled down by -12 dB (factor 0.25119)
gain_minus_12db.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

gain_plus_6db.name: Gain Boost (+6 dB with Soft Saturation)
gain_plus_6db.transformation_type: Waveform scaled up by +6 dB (factor 1.99526) and soft-clipped via tanh
gain_plus_6db.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

clipping_half.name: Mild Digital Clipping (Threshold 0.50)
clipping_half.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

reverb_rt60_200ms.name: Reverberation (RT60 = 0.20s)
reverb_rt60_200ms.transformation_type: RIR convolution simulating small conference room
reverb_rt60_200ms.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

speed_0_90x.name: Playback Speed 0.90x (Slow Speech)
speed_0_90x.transformation_type: Speech rate reduced by 10% via resampled time-stretch (-10% pitch shift)
speed_0_90x.mathematical_formula: Resample sr*0.9 to sr=16000, pad/crop to 16,000
speed_0_90x.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

speed_1_10x.name: Playback Speed 1.10x (Fast Speech)
speed_1_10x.transformation_type: Speech rate increased by 10% via resampled time-stretch (+10% pitch shift)
speed_1_10x.mathematical_formula: Resample sr*1.1 to sr=16000, pad/crop to 16,000
speed_1_10x.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

shift_minus_150ms.name: Early Onset Shift (-150 ms)
shift_minus_150ms.transformation_type: Waveform shifted left by 2,400 samples (onset moved earlier)
shift_minus_150ms.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0

shift_plus_150ms.name: Late Onset Shift (+150 ms)
shift_plus_150ms.transformation_type: Waveform shifted right by 2,400 samples (onset delayed)
shift_plus_150ms.preprocessor_normalizer_behavior: Does not cancel attenuation; only down-clamps if |x| > 1.0
